<!--
Combined print-out only. Loads neither `asreml` nor `JuliaCall`/`hsquared` --
it just reads the .rds files saved by dev-test/great_tit_asreml_model.qmd and
dev-test/great_tit_hsquared_model.qmd (render those two first, in that order).
-->

```{r}
#| label: packages
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
```

## Load saved results

```{r}
#| label: load-results
asreml_res   <- readRDS("dev-test/asreml_results.rds")
hsquared_res <- readRDS("dev-test/hsquared_results.rds")
```

## Runtime comparison

```{r}
#| label: compare-runtime
runtime_comparison <- tibble(
  Trait = rep(c("Clutch size", "Laying date"), each = 2),
  Engine = rep(c("ASReml", "hsquared"), times = 2),
  `Elapsed (s)` = c(
    asreml_res$time_cs[["elapsed"]],   hsquared_res$time_cs[["elapsed"]],
    asreml_res$time_ld[["elapsed"]],   hsquared_res$time_ld[["elapsed"]]
  )
)

runtime_comparison |>
  mutate(`Elapsed (s)` = round(`Elapsed (s)`, 3)) |>
  kable(caption = "Runtime comparison")
```

## Variance-component comparison

```{r}
#| label: compare-variance-components
variance_component_comparison <- bind_rows(
  asreml_res$vc_cs   |> mutate(Trait = "Clutch size", Engine = "ASReml"),
  hsquared_res$vc_cs |> mutate(Trait = "Clutch size", Engine = "hsquared"),
  asreml_res$vc_ld   |> mutate(Trait = "Laying date", Engine = "ASReml"),
  hsquared_res$vc_ld |> mutate(Trait = "Laying date", Engine = "hsquared")
) |>
  select(Trait, Engine, Component, Estimate, SE)

variance_component_comparison |>
  mutate(across(c(Estimate, SE), ~ round(., 4))) |>
  kable(caption = "Variance-component comparison")
```

## Heritability comparison

```{r}
#| label: compare-heritability
heritability_comparison <- bind_rows(
  tibble(Trait = "Clutch size", Engine = "ASReml",
         Heritability = asreml_res$h2_cs[["Estimate"]],
         SE = asreml_res$h2_cs[["SE"]]),
  tibble(Trait = "Clutch size", Engine = "hsquared",
         Heritability = hsquared_res$h2_cs$Estimate,
         SE = hsquared_res$h2_cs$SE),
  tibble(Trait = "Laying date", Engine = "ASReml",
         Heritability = asreml_res$h2_ld[["Estimate"]],
         SE = asreml_res$h2_ld[["SE"]]),
  tibble(Trait = "Laying date", Engine = "hsquared",
         Heritability = hsquared_res$h2_ld$Estimate,
         SE = hsquared_res$h2_ld$SE)
)

heritability_comparison |>
  mutate(across(c(Heritability, SE), ~ round(., 4))) |>
  kable(caption = "Heritability comparison")
```
